# Fighting Force Recharged 0.1.0-rc.1

Initial release candidate for the original English Windows version of
Fighting Force (1997). This is an unofficial compatibility and gameplay patch.
You must supply a supported retail disc or the reviewed English game folder;
no game executable, game assets, movies or music are included.

- Modern Windows presentation, focus recovery and smoother loading transitions.
- Widescreen gameplay and experimental 60 FPS interpolated rendering while
  retaining the native simulation cadence.
- Modern keyboard/mouse and XInput controls, remapping and controller feedback.
- Free third-person orbit, body-visible first-person view and experimental
  shared/dynamic split cameras for two players.
- Three campaign slots, automatic level-entry saves, Continue, previous-level
  recovery and confirmed level restart.
- Optional player guard, disabled by default.
- Disc installation or direct patching of a supported existing game folder,
  with original executables, libraries and assets preserved byte for byte.

Download the **Windows.zip** package for setup and user instructions. The
**Source.zip** archive is for development. Check the files against
**SHA256SUMS.txt**; **release.json** records the source revision and hashes.

Camera extensions, dynamic split screen and interpolated rendering remain
experimental. Full-campaign geometry, expanded save/pause screens and extended
two-controller play need broader live coverage. See the included documentation
for supported executables, controls, saves and known limits.
